changelog.summary: Adds a location-aware inventory evidence handoff from Catalog to Store Operations with merchant approval and retest.

title: Inventory Availability to Owner Action
description: Investigate a Shopify variant availability mismatch, prepare a location-aware merchant action, and verify the resulting inventory or storefront state.
setup_prompt: Use Inventory Availability to Owner Action as a chat-led proposal for one Shopify store, market, product variant, and location. Discover existing Catalog & Merchandising Analyst and Store Operations Coordinator Crews; propose reuse or reviewed creation. Inspect the actual ProductVariant, InventoryItem, InventoryLevel, market storefront, and any warehouse or supplier source. Show a validated location-aware handoff, owner decision, manual first run, and verification plan before Builder applies anything. Selection alone does not connect inventory, adjust quantity, place a purchase order, change product availability, or enable recurrence.

setup_inputs.label: Store, market, product, variant, inventory item, and location IDs
Authorized inventory authority, storefront, and warehouse or supplier source
Oversell, replenishment, and inventory adjustment policy with owner
One bounded availability mismatch or stock-risk case
Manual-only or reviewed recurrence and notification route

recommended_tools.name: Builder create_crew
recommended_tools.purpose: Create reviewed missing Crews with stable keys

recommended_tools.name: Builder manage_crew_attachment
recommended_tools.purpose: Pass a validated bounded variant/location artifact

recommended_tools.name: Shopify Admin or bounded inventory export
recommended_tools.purpose: Read ProductVariant, InventoryItem, and InventoryLevel by exact IDs

recommended_tools.name: Warehouse or supplier source
recommended_tools.purpose: Confirm external stock or replenishment evidence when applicable

recommended_tools.name: Public storefront browser
recommended_tools.purpose: Retest buyer-facing availability in the chosen market

pulse_focus.label: Inventory exception follow-through
focus_areas: Whether high-impact variant/location mismatches reach a named owner
Whether approved corrections are confirmed in source and storefront
review_when: An inventory mismatch repeats, a stock deadline approaches, or an approved action lacks retest evidence

outputs: Reviewed Crew roster and source authority map
Owner-reviewed action and optional provider receipt
Verified inventory/storefront state or unresolved case
